content: Israelwa uwau apanawa antone Dawid bola debama Ibron bedewe donsane ita waienase, “No ipa e dana moa.

Mapoido Sol ipa no wareremba, tane e Dawid dea osi Israelwa sorodiau uwau apanawa wainie mo banlamoiano nomoie ona awa antoie. Iawe God e dieene wanase, ‘E ne apanana Israelwa oniadewasamona, ambi gamo oniadewasala apanawa sipsipwa oniadewasamodia rua.’”

Tane walama sawo Israelwa apanau debamau uduudu bola debama Ibron bedewe Dawid mampe wimon, ita Dawid Israel apanawa do Iawe God emawe sauanton. Sa ipa Israel apanawa uwauntoia mena wadane Dawid uawa osowe memene euwamon me ipa tauma Israelwa warereu.
Tane Dawid enawa 30 wadedio, me warerelene Israel apanawa oniamono ena 40 dialen.
